name: The Beacon
fieldReading: Don't chase the signal. Become it.
bio: A fixed point of warm light in the dark — one who doesn't chase the crowd but becomes the place it gathers.
sceneStory: On a spit of black rock ringed by churning, silver-capped waves, a figure stands with feet apart and chest open, light pouring out of them in a wide amber road across the dark water. Far out along that road, a small three-masted ship with torn sails swings its bow around to come in.
assignments: You are not the one who goes looking.
You stand, and hold, and let the light go.
What is far off will turn toward the warm.
tagline: I don't search — I stay findable
